formula: Energy ~ load + ESMode1 + ESMode2 + ESMode3 + ESMode5 + ESMode6 + RUType + Mode + Frequency + Bandwidth + Antennas + TXpower + day + weekday_number + hour + (1 | BS)
notes: BeyondArena 5g_energy_consumption (Purucker et al. 2026, Table B.1: grouped regression), from Huawei's data of the ITU AI/ML in 5G energy consumption challenge (HuggingFace netop/5G-Network-Energy-Consumption): hourly energy of base stations with load, energy-saving modes and configuration. Task metadata: target Energy, group_on BS, group_labels per_sample; the curation splits by base station because the challenge stresses unseen stations. RUType, Mode, Frequency, Bandwidth, Antennas and TXpower describe the station; day, weekday_number and hour are the calendar features of the Zindi solution. No mixed model published. Hand check #162: the _Cell1 columns exist only for stations with a second cell; every task feature stays a covariate, the sparse ones included; a grouped prediction design, no mixed model documented. Correction #210: the five _Cell1 columns are missing from 94% of the rows, so the model that keeps them drops those rows; they are ignored (ADR 0002, amendment of 2026-11-19).

formula: rainfall ~ confidence + predicted_intensity + district + forecast_length + (1 | user_id) + (1 | community)
notes: BeyondArena ghanas_indigenous_intel (Purucker et al. 2026, Table B.1: temporal multiclass, no group_on), from Zindi's Ghana's Indigenous Intel challenge: farmers of the Pra River Basin forecast rain from indigenous signs in the Smart Indigenous Weather App, rainfall the rain their gauges later measured. Data Foundry's record names the units: the same farmers (user_id) in train and test, communities with one or several reporters, batches of reports that share one label; district (three) is a covariate. rainfall filed ordinal, NORAIN < SMALLRAIN < MEDIUMRAIN < HEAVYRAIN. prediction_time, the time axis of the split, is ignored. No mixed model published. Hand check #162: the source ranks rainfall NORAIN < SMALLRAIN < MEDIUMRAIN < HEAVYRAIN, which the loaded level order does not follow (#167); the sparse forecast inputs stay covariates; users and communities both group, users crossing communities. Correction #210: indicator, indicator_description and time_observed are missing from 95% to 99% of the rows, so the model that keeps them drops those rows; they are ignored (ADR 0002, amendment of 2026-11-19).
